items.explanation: "What … like?" is Jaki …?, agreeing with the noun: jaki sąsiad.
optionNotes: Jak asks "how"; a word-for-word copy of "how is…".
Jaka is feminine; sąsiad is masculine.

items.explanation: A noun is described with an adjective, and it agrees: mieszkanie jasne.
optionNotes: Jasno is an adverb; a noun needs an adjective.
Jasny is masculine; mieszkanie is neuter.
Mieć needs an object; use jest + adjective.

options: Ta kurtka jest za dużo droga.
items.explanation: "Too" before an adjective is za: za droga.
optionNotes: Za dużo means "too much"; before an adjective use only za.
Drogo is an adverb; kurtka needs the adjective droga.

items.explanation: To + noun phrase in the nominative; the adjective agrees with osoba (feminine): miła.
optionNotes: Miło is an adverb; osoba needs an adjective.
Osoba is feminine: miła, not miły.
Miłe is neuter or plural; osoba is feminine.
